info.title: Medblocks Public API
info.summary: Public read-only endpoints and machine-readable feeds published by medblocks.com.
info.description:
This document describes only the endpoints that medblocks.com publishes for third-party and automated use. It is intentionally narrow: other routes under /api are internal to the medblocks.com frontend, are not versioned, and are not supported for external callers.

All endpoints listed here are unauthenticated, read-only, and safe to retry.

tags.name: Certificates
tags.description: Verify a training certificate issued by Medblocks.

get.description: Returns the details of a certificate issued for completing a Medblocks course. Use this to confirm that a certificate presented by a candidate is genuine. The human-readable equivalent is https://medblocks.com/certificates/{id}.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The certificate identifier, as printed on the certificate.

404.description: No certificate exists with that identifier.

500.description: The certificate could not be looked up.

get.summary: RSS feed of the Medblocks blog
get.description: The 30 most recent articles on healthcare interoperability, FHIR, openEHR and SNOMED CT.
Points to the sitemaps listing every indexable page on the site. Documentation pages are covered by a separate sitemap at /docs/sitemap.xml.

course_name.description: Title of the course the certificate was issued for.

user_name.description: Name of the person the certificate was issued to.

date_created.description: When the certificate record was created.

date_updated.description: When the certificate record was last changed.

image.description: Identifier of the certificate image, when one has been generated.

error.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong.
